# balena_user_public_key (Resource)

Manages an user public key (the `user_public_key` resource of the `/v7` API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "balena_user_public_key" "example" {
  public_key = "example-public-key"
  title      = "example-title"
  user_id    = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `public_key` (String) API field `public_key` (text). At most 2850 characters. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `title` (String) API field `title` (short text). At most 120 characters.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the referenced `user` (API field `user`). Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) API field `created_at` (date time).
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the user public key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import balena_user_public_key.example 123456
```
